summary.text: Jordan Maynor is a Republican business owner and member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 41 who is seeking re-election against Democrat Curtis Shaver in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was appointed to the seat in 2021.

paragraphs.text: Jordan Maynor was born in Mount Hope, West Virginia, and lives in Beaver, West Virginia.
He earned a B.A. from Mountain State University in 2012 and an M.B.A. from West Virginia University in 2015.

His career experience includes owning and serving as CEO of Maynor Consulting and Maynor Rentals, working as a field representative for U.S. Representative Evan Jenkins, and serving as regional political director of the Tennessee Republican Party.
Governor Jim Justice appointed Maynor to the House of Delegates on August 19, 2021, to succeed Jeffrey Pack, who resigned that July.
